problem: Long supported exact-approval transactions take FOR UPDATE on sources. Independent raw_snapshots inserts require foreign-key FOR KEY SHARE on that same row and can block until the collector deadline.

staging_observation.logs: Evidence flush interrupted by total_run deadline; rollback reports another command already in progress. Source-row blocking as the historical staging cause is an inference; no historical pg_locks sample was retained.

local_reproduction: Both supported source locking paths failed an independent mock RAW insert with PostgreSQL LockNotAvailable. Driver context names sources and foreign-key FOR KEY SHARE. After fix both retain independently committed RAW while the approval remains open.
fix: Use PostgreSQL FOR NO KEY UPDATE (SQLAlchemy with_for_update(key_share=True), read=False) for the same source-row mutex on both writer paths. Competing supported approvals still take conflicting exclusive locks; foreign-key KEY SHARE can persist raw. All identity, current-listing, print/source and duplicate checks stay identical.

explicit_checks: RAW inserts persist with the approval uncommitted
Second supported writer on either source path receives lock timeout until the first ends
Concurrent different listings for one physical print yield one mapping and one guarded refusal
Concurrent identical approval replay stays one mapping
Domain service never commits and failure rolls back all mapping state

impact: Staging API shared supported-mapping writer only. No schema, source budget, cron, queue, approval, price, history, feature-flag or production operation during delivery. Existing serialized source service components must be adopted and strictly verified.

rollback.procedure: Stop the affected bulk approval path and fix forward prior source mutex code if mutual exclusion or integrity fails. Leave collector-owned work and all raw, observations, immutable decisions/history intact.

post_delivery: Reverify exact API and adopted collector components, migration, sale hiding and immutable gaps; freshly regenerate state. Use current delivered domain code for subsequent bounded approvals and verify ordinary scheduled RAW persists without source-lock deadline failures. No manual jobs or backoff resets.
